001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.format;
002
003import io.jstach.rainbowgum.annotation.CaseChanging;
004import io.jstach.rainbowgum.annotation.EnumAlias;
005
006/**
007 * A field every event has, for the <code>columns</code> property of the <code>ltsv</code>
008 * encoder.
009 */
010@CaseChanging
011public enum EventField {
012
013        /**
014         * Time.
015         */
016        @EnumAlias("timestamp")
017        TIME,
018        /**
019         * Level.
020         */
021        LEVEL,
022        /**
023         * Logger name.
024         */
025        LOGGER,
026        /**
027         * Thread fields, see {@link ThreadFields}.
028         */
029        THREAD,
030        /**
031         * Message.
032         */
033        @EnumAlias("msg")
034        MESSAGE;
035
036        static EventField parse(String value) {
037                return switch (value.strip().toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT)) {
038                        case "timestamp" -> TIME;
039                        case "msg" -> MESSAGE;
040                        default -> io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperty.enumValue(EventField.class, value, "timestamp", "msg");
041                };
042        }
043
044}
